audience: UAE finance teams and accountants that send e-invoices through Marmin

useCases.title: Check the Peppol status of this week's invoices
useCases.text: List the invoices of a period, newest first. Read the Peppol status of each invoice to see which ones are pending, approved, rejected or failed validation.

useCases.title: Find out why an invoice was rejected
useCases.text: Open the Peppol status log of a rejected invoice to read each event and its message. Then read the invoice lines and totals to check the data.

useCases.title: Review the purchase invoices of one supplier
useCases.text: List the purchase invoices of one supplier by VAT number. Open an invoice to read its parties, lines, tax breakdown and totals.

useCases.title: Read the UBL XML of an e-invoice
useCases.text: Read the UAE e-invoice XML (UBL 2.1, PINT AE) of an invoice or credit note. Use it to check the exact e-invoice data.

useCases.title: Check the business profiles and their onboarding
useCases.text: List the business profiles of your organization with their TRN, Peppol endpoint and onboarding status. Open one profile for its address and trade license.
